summary: Squashed all prior git history into a single clean commit, at user request. Prior iterative development history (rebranding, crash-hardening rounds, the update-checking pipeline fixes, the toolbar wiring, the patch-install feature build-out) is preserved in .agents/decisions.md (ADRs) and .agents/memory.md (gotchas/invariants) rather than in git log.

summary: Reverted the v1.0.0 tag/release/zip: deleted the GitHub release, its zip asset, and the git tag. Corrected _meta.lua version to 0.3.0 -- v1.0.0 overstated readiness by framing testing done under Xvfb (KOReader's official prebuilt Linux binary -- a real runtime, not headless mocks, but still a desktop simulation, not physical e-reader hardware) as "tested, working" without making that distinction. Amended the squashed commit message and .agents/memory.md to state the testing scope precisely, and to warn against claiming real-device testing anywhere until it has actually happened on physical hardware.
author: devhax
